Port the Thrift-only slice of #20675, stacked on #20715. Serialized server failures without a Throwable receive `error.type="_OTHER"` in RPC preview and duplicate modes.

```properties
otel.semconv-stability.preview=rpc
```

- **Classification:** Preserve specific transport error codes, Throwable-based fallback, and legacy telemetry.
- **Coverage:** Update synchronous/asynchronous server-span expectations and assert synchronous RPC duration error types: `_OTHER` on the server and `org.apache.thrift.TApplicationException` on the client.
metadata.title: Classify serialized Thrift failures in RPC preview telemetry
